strategies.name: ma_cross_20_60_trend100
strategies.description: Buy when the 20-period MA crosses above the 60-period MA, with price above the 100-period trend MA; exit when the MAs cross back.

source.quote: generates a BUY signal when the fast moving average ( or MA) crosses up over the slower moving average.

decisions: MA type not stated; simple MAs used.
Book uses the 100 MA to judge trend strength, not as an entry gate; requiring close > sma(100) is our filter to cut ranging-market false signals the book warns about (p. 9).
Book has no stop; exit is the reverse cross. A 3x ATR(14) catastrophe stop added.
Reverse-cross exit (sma20 < sma60) is not available; close<ema50 trailing used as the nearest approximation (EMA50 sits near SMA60).
Book's 3% max risk capped to 1%.
uncodable: Short side: sell when fast MA crosses below slow MA.

strategies.name: heikin_ashi_two_green_stoch_reversal
strategies.description: Daily Heikin-Ashi reversal: two completed green HA candles after a run of red ones, Stochastic(14,7,3) coming out of oversold, enter on a break of the second green candle's high.

source.quote: If the price prints two consecutive green candles, after a series of red candles, the downtrend is exhausted and the reversal is likely.

decisions: Heikin-Ashi candles not available; regular candle colours used as a rough approximation (bars 1-2 green, bars 3-4 red). Real HA colour runs are smoother and longer.
p. 15 says long after two RED candles with Stochastic above 70, contradicting p. 14; treated as a typo. Long = two green candles after reds with Stochastic having been oversold (<30).
Stochastic(14,7,3) not available; 'oversold within the last 5 bars' approximated with rsi(14) < 35 within 5 bars.
Buy-stop a few pips above the second green candle's high approximated by close > high[1].
Book stop is 100 pips flat or local technical level; local level = lowest_low(5) (covers the red run).
Book says let winners run and trail to local lows; PSAR trailing used. Break-even after 50 pips not expressible.
Book's 3% max risk capped to 1%.
Oversold = Stochastic(14,7,3) %K below 30 within the last 5 bars (the book shows the oscillator on charts without a level).
uncodable: Short side: two red HA candles after greens with Stochastic overbought.
Avoid bank holidays, NFP, FOMC and central-bank speech days (news calendar).
Don't enter right after a volatile one-way swing (discretionary).
Exit on opposite HA signal.
Not coded yet: accelerator_oscillator (optional AC > 0 green-bar filter)
Not coded yet: move stop to break-even after +X% (book: +50 pips)
Not coded yet: buy-stop order entry at high of signal bar

strategies.name: swing_correction_range_breakout
strategies.description: In an uptrend, wait for a tight overlapping correction (contracting volatility), then buy when two candles close above the correction's range top; stop at the correction low.

source.quote: A trader would buy the open of the following candle and place a stop at the lowest point of the correction.

decisions: Prior trend = close above ema(200) (book only says 'the trend that had started the previous week').
'Contracting range, lots of overlap' approximated by band-width percentile < 0.2 within the last 10 bars.
'Two separate candles moved above the upper blue line' = two consecutive closes above the prior 12-bar high (range of the correction).
Stop at the lowest point of the correction = lowest_low(20) (book example had 26 candles in the range).
Book example had ~30 pt risk vs ~600 pt gain but gives no target; 3R target plus EMA50 trail chosen.
Book chart was EURUSD 4h.
uncodable: Short side: sell when the first candle breaks below the contracting range in a downtrend, stop at the minor swing high.
Not coded yet: range_overlap / range contraction of last N bars (e.g. (highest_high(n)-lowest_low(n))/atr)

strategies.name: bullish_engulfing_next_candle
strategies.description: Buy after a bullish engulfing candle; stop at the engulfing candle's low; trail with the trend.

source.quote: Your stop should be placed at the low of the engulfing candle.

decisions: Engulfing approximated with OHLC comparisons: prior bar red, current bar green, current body covers prior body.
Book says wait for the following candle then enter; signal evaluated on the engulfing bar close, entry assumed at next bar open.
Stop = low of the engulfing (signal) bar.
No target in book; 2R target plus EMA50 trail chosen.
Book notes engulfing more candles is stronger; only a 1-candle engulf is required here.
uncodable: Bearish engulfing short with stop at engulfing high.

strategies.name: long_lower_shadow_reversal
strategies.description: Buy the open after a candle whose lower shadow is at least twice its real body at a turning point; stop at the shadow low, trailed.

source.quote: The ‘shadow’ should be at least twice the length of the real body of the candle.

decisions: Shadow/body ratio cannot be computed with the grammar; best-effort approximation only (NOT faithful): bar makes a 10-bar low but closes back above the prior bar's low, with RSI(14) < 45 as the 'turning point' context.
Stop at the shadow extreme = signal bar low; trailing per book via PSAR.
30-bar time stop added because the book gives no target.
uncodable: Long upper shadow short setup.

strategies.name: hammer_reversal
strategies.description: Buy the open after a hammer (small body at the top of the candle, long lower handle); stop at the hammer low, trailed.

source.quote: We wait for the long hammer candle to close and we place our trade at the open of the next candle.

decisions: Hammer shape not expressible; best-effort: after a >3% 5-bar decline, bar makes a new 10-bar low but closes green and above prior close. Not a true hammer test.
Stop = hammer low; PSAR trail per 'trailed to follow the trend'. 30-bar time stop added.
uncodable: Inverted/shooting-star short version.

strategies.name: role_reversal_pullback_20ma
strategies.description: In an uptrend (higher highs/lows) after a breakout to a new high, buy the pullback to the 20 MA / broken-resistance zone.

source.quote: 1/3 at 20MA, 1/3 at role reversal, 1/3 at 50% Fib retracement.

decisions: Only the first of the three scaled limit entries (the 20 MA tranche) is coded; the role-reversal and 50% Fib tranches need missing features.
'Price punched through resistance' = a new 20-bar high within the last 10 bars; the pullback must then touch the 20 SMA and hold it on the close.
Stop below the swing low (lowest_low(20)); book only says 'risk management must be applied'.
2R target and 40-bar time stop chosen; book targets a new higher high.
uncodable: Short side: broken support becomes resistance in downtrends.
Not coded yet: horizontal_sr_zone / broken_resistance_level
Not coded yet: fib_retracement(swing, 0.382 / 0.5)
Not coded yet: pivot_points
Not coded yet: scaled limit-order entries (3 tranches)

strategies.name: bb_squeeze_mid_break
strategies.description: After a Bollinger(20,2) squeeze, buy when a full candle closes above the middle band; stop at the prior candle's low.

source.quote: A BUY signal is generated when a full candle completes above the simple moving average line.

decisions: Book's squeeze threshold is absolute EURUSD band width ~0.0100; replaced with a relative test: width percentile < 0.15 over 120 bars within the last 5 bars.
'Full candle completes above the SMA' = whole bar (its low) above the middle band, with the previous bar not fully above (first such bar).
Stop at low of preceding candle = lowest_low(1). Book's alternative 3%-of-capital cap is handled by risk_pct (capped to 1%).
No target in book; 2R and 30-bar time stop chosen.
uncodable: Short side: full candle completes below the middle band, stop at preceding high.

strategies.name: narrow_range_nr7_breakout
strategies.description: Buy when price breaks above the high of the narrowest-range candle of the last 7 (or 4) bars; stop at that candle's low.

source.quote: A BUY signal is generated when the price moves above the high of the narrow candle.

decisions: Book: narrowest range of the past 4 or 7 days, daily charts; NR7 chosen (NR4 = same with 4).
Bar range not directly available; approximated by previous bar's ATR(1) (true range) being under 0.6x the 7-bar ATR ending the bar before. Not an exact NR7 test.
Buy-stop above the narrow candle high approximated by a close above high[1].
Stop at narrow candle low (low[1]), trailed (PSAR) per book; 2R target and 10-bar time stop added because it is 'very short term'.
uncodable: Short side: break below narrow candle low.
Not coded yet: buy-stop entry at prior bar high

strategies.name: rsi2_momentum_above_90
strategies.description: Momentum use of RSI(2): buy when RSI(2) moves above 90 in an uptrend; exit on the opposing signal (RSI(2) below 10).

source.quote: A BUY signal is generated when the 2 period RSI moves above 90.

decisions: Book exit is RSI(2) moving below 10; not an allowed trailing rule. close<ema50 trail used as a proxy, recorded in needs.
Book warns of whipsaw in ranges and says the merit shows in trends; close > ema(200) trend filter added (our choice).
'Rigorous stop loss regime' with no number: 1.5x ATR(14) chosen.
50-bar time stop added.
uncodable: Short side: sell when RSI(2) moves below 10.
Adding to positions on repeated signals.
Not coded yet: pyramiding: add a position on each further RSI(2) > 90 trigger

strategies.name: momentum_reversal_stoch_support
strategies.description: Daily setup: after a clear decline, with daily (and weekly) stochastic oversold at a major support zone, buy on an intraday bullish reversal.

source.quote: The price declined and reached a support at 117 area. The momentum is now oversold.

decisions: Long side is counter to a down-move, so the book's 'lower lot size for counter-trend' is reflected with risk_pct 0.005 unless a fundamental uptrend bias exists.
'Clearly falling recently' = 10-bar change below -8% (crypto-scaled).
Stochastic oversold (<30) approximated with RSI(14) < 30 within 5 bars; weekly stochastic not available.
Major support approximated as price within 2% of the 60-bar low.
Intraday 'bullish reversal price pattern' unspecified; approximated by close above prior bar high.
Book holds up to several weeks with no target; 3R and 60-bar time stop chosen.
uncodable: Fundamental/COT trend bias.
Pending limit orders in London session.
Short setups at overbought resistance (setups #1-#3 in the book's example).
